description: Posts a team note about nobody in particular (a heads-up for the office, e.g. the van is in the shop) to the day's Ops Summary activity, as the note box does. A note ABOUT a contact belongs on that contact's record instead (add_client_note). Nothing is sent to a client. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying a repeat.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: post_team_note
title: Post a team note
